review_candidates.title: Clinical Research Assistant / Clinical Research Associate / Clinical Research Manager
review_candidates.description: Role Description These roles support clinical studies from site preparation through close-out. They work with investigators, study coordinators, sponsors, and data teams to protect participant confidentiality, maintain accurate study records, and keep study activities on schedule. The Clinical Research Assistant coordinates study visits, maintains study files and screening logs, and helps enter and verify data under supervision. The Clinical Research Associate monitors trial sites, reviews informed consent records and study documentation, and follows up on protocol deviations and monitoring findings. The Clinical Research Manager oversees study timelines, budgets, and staffing, coordinates work across sites and vendors, and escalates risks that could affect participant safety, data quality, or study delivery. Qualifications Degree or diploma in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, Public Health, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience in clinical research support, site monitoring, or study management relevant to the position. Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), study protocols, informed consent, and participant confidentiality. Ability to maintain accurate study documentation and work with electronic data capture or clinical trial management systems. For assistant roles, experience coordinating study visits, maintaining study files, or entering and checking study data under supervision. For associate roles, experience conducting site monitoring visits, writing monitoring reports, and verifying that sites address findings. For manager roles, experience leading study teams, managing budgets and milestones, and overseeing site or vendor performance. Clear communication and sound judgement when documenting deviations, handling sensitive information, and escalating concerns promptly.
